QUOTE: They are copied into `PermissionManager` when `ServerManager` is constructed (`server_manager.cpp:32–36`, called from `facade/entropic.cpp:792`). Later config edits do not affect it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names PermissionManager and says the allow/deny lists come from the permissions config, parsed from YAML and copied in when ServerManager is constructed.
